sermorelin is GHRH(1-29) and signals the pituitary
CJC-1295 is a longer-acting investigational GHRH analog
ipamorelin is a ghrelin-receptor GHSR agonist
HGH or somatropin is direct exogenous growth hormone
no universal best; diagnosis evidence regulatory status monitoring and individual risk matter

posts.topic: Peptide vs protein vs small molecule
focus: peptides are relatively short amino-acid chains linked by peptide bonds
FDA uses 40 or fewer amino acids as one regulatory peptide threshold
proteins are longer complex amino-acid chains whose folding can determine function
small molecules are compact chemical compounds rather than amino-acid chains
classification alone does not establish quality safety effectiveness approval or strength of evidence
